cypher: MATCH (n0:Dairy) WHERE n0.dairy_label = 'Marrow Clough Farm' RETURN n0.herd_note AS value

values: "Brown Swiss herd of 35, summer pasture only"

start.means:
A farm dairy that makes young cheeses and sends them to the cellar. Dairy
names are not unique; the dairy reference is. An unrecorded herd note
means nobody described the herd, not that the dairy keeps no animals.

cypher: MATCH (n0:Wheel) WHERE n0.wheel_tag = 'NM-CH-0004' RETURN n0.weighed_at AS value

start.means:
One whole cheese wheel under maturation. made_by is the dairy that
produced the curd; finished_by is the dairy that gave the final wash
and rind, and the two may be the same. weight_grams is a constant
quantity in grams. made_on is an ISO date and weighed_at is UTC Unix
milliseconds. An unrecorded rind remark means no rind inspection was
written down.
